question: Which of harness / backend / strip_lines-default blocks the cheapest liteinst cell (getpid) from becoming the first BITWISE-parity cell (full INFO-log match with identical virtual-time timestamps)?
answer: The backend. liteinst's in-guest instrumentation issues guest-observable syscalls (libreverie_liteinst.so load, 72x /proc/self/maps scans, fd fstats) that detcore commits to the deterministic timeline; virtual time diverges at COMMIT turn 2 and liteinst runs 32 turns vs ptrace's 6, so the DETLOG cannot be byte-identical. strip_lines is shallow (bypassed via --log-file/--verify-verbose); harness is modest (cross-backend unstripped diff reproduced by hand from existing primitives).
